context: Accessibility platform providing tools, widget features, audit checks, and inclusive digital solutions for web developers and organizations

components_to_enhance: Interactive Accessibility Toolbar (Text resizing, high contrast, dyslexia font, screen reader simulation, grayscale)
WCAG Compliance Audit Checker Simulator with real-time scoring
Solutions & Features Bento Grid with high contrast cards
Interactive Pricing & Integration Code Generator for developers
instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve all existing accessibility features and functionalities from the reference site. Elevate the design using high contrast, generous spacing, smooth typography, interactive widgets, and robust testids for all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes
Do not use transparent headers or overlays without proper blur
Ensure APCA/WCAG contrast compliance across all components
Rotate font weights and use distinct headings
